THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land describedbelow is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

An allotment of land called ‘Rajjammana Watta’ in total extentof about 0.1700 Hectare, depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Ma/MTL/2014/03 dated 26th June, 2014 prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village of Rajjammana (F.V.P. 25) inGampahasiyapattuwa Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary'sDivision of Matale in Matale District, in Central Province andbounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Rajjammana Watta – Extent: About 0.1700HectareNorth: Remaining portion of the same land, Road and Foot path;East: Foot path and Ambanganga Reservation; South: AmbangangaReservation and Remaining portion of the same land; West: Remainingportion of the same land
M. K. A. D. S. Gunawardana,Minister of Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2013/WS/425.Ministry of Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.13th May, 2015.
